definitions.short: Shirjon or Sirjon , a peak of the Lebanon
definitions.full: H8303. Siryon וֺן שִׂרְיֹן, - proper name, of a mountain (in Assyrian Sirara COT Deut 3:9 ; 1Kin 5:13 Dl Pa 103 f. ); — Sidonian name of Hermon Deut 3:9 ( Σανιωρ ); וֺן - Psa 29:6 (+ לְבָנוֺן ; van d. H. and others ׳שׁ ).
definitions.rootNote: and שִׂרְיֹן ; the same as 8304 (i.e. sheeted with snow);
